definitions: To stand or march as a demonstrator, especially outside a place of work to protest against a company or to deter people from entering during a strike.
To enclose (an area) with pickets or stakes.
To tether (an animal) to a picket.
examples: The workers decided to picket the factory gates.
They will picket the building all day.
The union plans to picket the company's headquarters.
He picketed his horse in the meadow.
